Name: Magenta Haired Leah
Author: Mymlala
Description:
As a matter of personal taste I felt like the haircolors of the single peeps in Stardew Valley was somewhat narrow... too many redheads. So I went ahead and edited the reclusive artist Leah's hair to be a lovely vibrant magenta color!

(note: some other minor tweaks of color were made as well... like giving those dull grey pants some color as well as changing the color of her boots)

I will put up two versions of this mod for download. One is a simple xnb file replacer (that can be drag-drop merged with the main Content folder of the game) and the other will be for users of SMAPI 2.5 and Pathoschild's Content Patcher. Those can be found at the following locations:

SMAPI: https://canimod.com/
and
Content Patcher: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915

Either way... Hope you enjoy this simple lil' mod! ~ Mym
